name: Sinege Danneun Bam
source:
A girl wandering through the forest encounters a man.

He stands beneath a tree with a quiet smile—
but he is not human.

A god who watches over the river,
and a human who has wandered into his forest after a long journey.

Two beings who were never meant to be together
slowly find their way into each other’s hearts over the course of a single night.

With fate drawing near,
what ending will your choices bring to that night?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4846320/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在森林中徘徊的少女邂逅了一名男子。

他面带静谧的微笑伫立在树下——
却并非人类。

守护河川的神明，
与长途跋涉后误入他森林的人类少女。

本不该有所交集的两个生命，
在短短一夜之间，悄然走进了彼此的心房。

随着宿命步步逼近，
你的抉择将为这一夜带来怎样的结局？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4846320/]Steam[/url]]
